Priya (CS): forwarding from ACME: customer lost connection mid-stream, reconnected and saw full output again and a duplicate billing charge. wanted urgent help, says they were charged twice for same response tokens. attaching repro steps from their client. :frowning:

Sanjay (Eng): thanks. can you paste their client code + headers? most duplicate charges we've seen are from missing resume/idempotency headers.

Priya (CS): they sent this snippet (JS SSE client):
```js
const es = new EventSource(url, { withCredentials: true });
es.onmessage = (e) => { /* append chunk */ }
es.onerror = () => { /* reconnect logic: new EventSource(url) after 1s */ };
// they do not persist any resume token or idempotency key client-side
```

Mario (SRE): hmm. server logs for their org at 2026-05-02T15:03Z show: 
```
[15:03:12] session: abc123 resume_token missing -> started new session id: s-789
[15:03:13] generation: request id r-456 produced 842 tokens cost=0.084
[15:05:01] client reconnect -> new request id r-457 produced 842 tokens cost=0.084
```
This looks like two independent generations.

Sanjay (Eng): that matches idempotency gap. Our resume semantics need either: persistent resume-token + session-offset resume OR client-supplied idempotency key on POST to avoid double-gen. If client drops resume token we treat as fresh.

Priya (CS): ACME says their client *thinks* it resumed because UI got earlier partial output, they call reconnect hoping to continue, not knowing session token was lost. result: they saw partial content immediately (cached) then full repeated tokens on new generation.

Olivia (Product): this looks like UX risk + billing risk. We should consider a quick mitigation: server-side dedupe within short window for identical prompt+context for same org+user, and mark as "suspected-dup" for billing hold.

Sanjay (Eng): short-term engineering fix: 1) require client to persist resumetoken in localStorage for SSE clients and include `Resume-Token: <token>` on reconnect; 2) accept optional `X-Idempotency-Key` header to dedupe immediate replays. I'll draft PR for header support.

Mario (SRE): operational patch: add a billing rule that flags two same-size generations from same org with <=2s separation and identical prompt hash. Do not auto-charge until human review. I'll open an incident ticket to suspend automated billing for flagged cases.

Priya (CS): repro steps from ACME to reproduce (they included):
1) open SSE stream to /v1/streams?model=x
2) wait until chunk about 40% through
3) kill client TCP (network blip)
4) reconnect immediately with a fresh EventSource and no resume header
Result: UI shows cached partial output then new full output. Billing: two charges.

Sanjay (Eng): sample server-side suggestion to support resume header (pseudo):
```
POST /v1/streams
Headers: Resume-Token: <token>
         X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
Body: { prompt, opts }
```
If Resume-Token present -> attempt resume at offset, else if Idempotency-Key seen recently -> return cached result.

Priya (CS): ACME wants ETA for fix and whether we can refund duplicate charges.

Mario (SRE): I'll put billing flag in place today (low-risk rule) and pause charges on matches. Refund policy: ops + finance need to sign off, but we can do manual refunds immediately for confirmed duplicates.

Olivia (Product): from product side, let's add a short doc for SSE best-practices (persist resume token, attach idempotency key on reconnect) and update quickstarts. Also add warning in Console about reconnects causing duplicate generation if resume token lost.

Sanjay (Eng): action items: (1) PR to accept X-Idempotency-Key + short in-memory dedupe window (48h TTL for keys) — on it, aim for 3 days. (2) follow-up: implement resume header semantics and session binding. (3) QA: write a repro harness that simulates abrupt TCP drop and reconnect.

Priya (CS): I'll reply to ACME with interim guidance: persist resume token + include idempotency header if reconnecting. Also tell them we flagged potential duplicates and billing team will follow up. :thumbsup:

reconnect-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-113 created for billing hold and QA harness (link: https://tracker/internal/INC-2026-113)

Sanjay (Eng): thanks — looping in eng-ml if we need model-side KV resume logic later.

Priya (CS): marking as escalated. will update thread when billing/PR progress.
